name: enrich-contact-records
description: Enrich Notion contact records with a work email and profile signals via BetterContact. The request is an async waterfall job: the durable submits it with its own ctx.createCallback URL as the webhook, parks, and resumes when BetterContact posts the terminated result (polling get_contact is the fallback when the webhook never arrives, incl. the on_hold out-of-credits state). Requires first + last name and a company domain (Company rollup, else the corporate Primary Email host). An enriched email is written only when corroborated against something the CRM already holds — a shared address, the contact's LinkedIn profile, the known company domain, or the request being gated on the contact's own domain + name — and only when BetterContact verifies it deliverable or catch_all_safe; an uncorroborated or unverified address is named in the outcome comment and written nowhere. A corroborated work address takes Primary Email when the existing Primary is a consumer mailbox; a corporate Primary is left alone. Empty webhook pings are skipped without raising. Replaced the Apollo → Lusha → NinjaPear cascade on 2026-09-18.
enrichment_note: BetterContact returns no bio, no photo (contact_avatar is a documented always-null legacy key) and rarely a job title on an email-only waterfall, so Bio is left as it is. The former Path C icon/cover update was removed 2026-09-18 — no acceptable source returns photos. Callback timeout 600s, then 5 polls 60s apart. The callback URL host is code-substrate-runner.zapier.com (not the SDK default); verified live 2026-09-18.
